description.p: Ingatku keeps your grocery list, projects and daily tasks in one place and reminds you when it is time. Everything is saved on your own computer.

ul.li: Checklists for groceries, projects and daily tasks
Start and end alarms, with an optional pre-alert up to one hour before
A description and a tick-box checklist inside every item
Extend or reschedule an item in a few clicks
Pastel colours, pinned favourites and several ways to sort
A notes page that is always saved

screenshot.caption: Your lists with start and end times

description.p: Pastel box colours, a time picker you can type in, and sorting by shortest or longest time.
